question: What will be the difference in population 3 years ago and 2 years ago of a town whose current population of 1,40,000 is increasing at a rate of 25% every year?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Rate** = 25% = 1/4 (Growth factor = 5/4 per year)

Population 3 years ago (P₃) = 1,40,000 ÷ (5/4)³ = 1,40,000 × 64/125 = 71,680

Population 2 years ago (P₂) = P₃ × 5/4 = 71,680 × 5/4 = 89,600

**Difference** = 89,600 − 71,680 = 17,920

**∴ The correct answer is 17,920.**
